# Azure Enterprise Infra Planner — Landing Zones & Networks

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's skill for cloud architects and platform engineers: describe a workload and get enterprise Azure infrastructure planned through a 7-phase gated pipeline — extract insights, research best practices and Well-Architected Framework guidance, generate the plan, then (only after your explicit approval) generate Bicep or Terraform for landing zones, hub-spoke networks, VNets, firewalls, private endpoints, identity/RBAC and multi-region disaster-recovery topologies, with hardened gates (IaC must pass `az bicep build`/`terraform validate` plus a checkov security scan before any deploy). By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: built for greenfield and brownfield (existing resources are referenced, never recreated) — but this is the heavyweight path; prefer azure-prepare for app-centric workflows.
